question: Which of the following Constitutional Amendment Act added the Right to Education to the Indian constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**86th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 21 A was added by the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2002.

 
 
• This article declares that the State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of six to fourteen years in such a manner as the State may determine.
 
• This article deals with the concept of inclusive education, Specific terms in inclusive education such as Impairment, Disability, Special Educational Needs, Learning Difficulties, Reasons For Inclusion, Provisions for Children With Special Needs, etc.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 __Amendment Acts__
 __Year__
 __Provisions__
 
 

 42nd
 1976
 
 
 
• Added Socialist, Secular& integrity in Preamble, Added Fundamental duties(Part IV A). 
 
• Creation of All India Judicial Service.
 
• Extended the time limit of President's rule from 6 months to 1 year.
 
• Added 3 new directive principles.
 
• Raised tenure of Lok Sabha &State legislature assemblies from 5 to 6 years;
 
• Proclamation of national emergency.
 
• Made obligatory for President to act on the advice of the Council of Ministers. 
 
 
 
 

 44th
 1978
 
 
 
• Modified emergency provision. Deleted right to property from Fundamental rights.
 
• Fundamental rights are guaranteed by articles 20 and 21cannot be suspended during a national emergency 
 
 
 
 

 61st
 1988
 
 
 
• Reduced voting age from 21 to 18 years for Lok Sabha as well as assembly election
 
 
 
 

 86th
 2002
 
 
 
• Made elementary education a fundamental right, Added article 21 A – free & compulsory education to all the children of 6-14 years.
 
• Added new fundamental duty under Article 51-A.
